notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Croaking Counterpart
description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of Naru Meha that is a 1/1 Frog.
Put the Naru Meha token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
